entries.name: sklego.feature_selection.MaximumRelevanceMinimumRedundancy
entries.summary: Maximum Relevance Minimum Redundancy (MRMR) is an iterative feature selection method commonly used in data science to select a subset of features from a larger feature set. The goal of MRMR is to choose features that have high relevance to the target variable while minimizing redundancy among the already selected features.

entries.name: sklego.meta.decay_estimator.exponential_decay
entries.summary: Generates an exponential decay by mapping input data `X`, `y` to a exponential decreasing range $w_{t-1} = decay\_rate * w_{t}$. The length of the decay is determined by the number of samples in `y`.

entries.name: sklego.meta.decay_estimator.linear_decay
entries.summary: Generates a linear decay by mapping input data `X`, `y` to a linearly decreasing range from `max_value` to `min_value`. The length and step of the decay is determined by the number of samples in `y`.

entries.name: sklego.meta.decay_estimator.sigmoid_decay
entries.summary: Generates a sigmoid decay function that maps input data `X`, `y` to a non-linearly decreasing range from `max_value` to `min_value`. The steepness of the decay is determined by the `growth_rate` parameter. If not provided this will be set to `10 / n_samples`, which is a "good enough" default for most cases.

entries.name: sklego.meta.decay_estimator.stepwise_decay
entries.summary: Generates a stepwise decay function that maps input data `X`, `y` to a decreasing range from `max_value` to `min_value`.

entries.name: sklego.preprocessing.InformationFilter
entries.summary: The `InformationFilter` transformer uses a variant of the [Gram-Schmidt process](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gram%E2%80%93Schmidt_process) to filter information out of the dataset.

members.name: fit
members.summary: Fit the transformer by learning the projection required to make the dataset orthogonal to sensitive columns.

members.name: transform
members.summary: Transforms `X` by applying the information filter.

entries.name: sklego.preprocessing.IntervalEncoder
entries.summary: The `IntervalEncoder` transformer bends features in `X` with regards to`y`.

members.name: fit
members.summary: Fit the `IntervalEncoder` transformer by computing interpolation quantiles for each column of `X`.

members.name: transform
members.summary: Performs smoothing on the column(s) of `X` according to the quantile values computed during fitting.

entries.name: sklego.preprocessing.LinearEmbedder
entries.summary: Embed features using coefficients from a linear model.

members.name: fit
members.summary: Fit the linear estimator and store the coefficients for embedding.

members.name: transform
members.summary: Transform the data by rescaling with learned coefficients.

entries.name: sklego.preprocessing.MonotonicSplineTransformer
entries.summary: The `MonotonicSplineTransformer` integrates the output of the `SplineTransformer` in an attempt to make monotonic features.

members.name: fit
members.summary: Fit the `MonotonicSplineTransformer` transformer by computing the spline transformation of `X`.

members.name: transform
members.summary: Performs the Ispline transformation on `X`.

entries.name: sklego.preprocessing.OrthogonalTransformer
entries.summary: The `OrthogonalTransformer` transforms the columns of a dataframe or numpy array to orthogonal (or orthonormal if `normalize=True`) matrix.

members.name: fit
members.summary: Fit the transformer to the input data by calculating the inverse of R of the QR decomposition of `X`. This can be used to calculate the orthogonal projection of `X`.

members.name: transform
members.summary: Transforms `X` using the fitted inverse of R. Normalizes the result if required.

entries.name: sklego.preprocessing.OutlierRemover
entries.summary: The `OutlierRemover` transformer removes outliers (train-time only) using the supplied removal model. The removal model should implement `.fit()` and `.predict()` methods.

members.name: fit
members.summary: Fit the estimator on training data `X` and `y` by fitting the underlying outlier detector if `refit` is True.

members.name: transform_train
members.summary: Removes outliers from `X` using the fitted estimator.

entries.name: sklego.preprocessing.PandasTypeSelector
entries.summary: !!! warning "Deprecated since version 0.9.0, please use TypeSelector instead"

entries.name: sklego.preprocessing.RandomAdder
entries.summary: The `RandomAdder` transformer adds random noise to the input data.

members.name: fit
members.summary: Fit the transformer on training data `X` and `y` by checking the input data and record the number of input features.

members.name: transform_train
members.summary: Transform training data by adding random noise sampled from $N(0, \text{noise})$.

entries.name: sklego.preprocessing.RepeatingBasisFunction
entries.summary: The `RepeatingBasisFunction` transformer is designed to be used when the input data has a circular nature.

members.name: fit
members.summary: Fit `RepeatingBasisFunction` transformer on input data `X`. It uses `sklearn.compose.ColumnTransformer`.

members.name: transform
members.summary: Transform input data `X` with fitted `RepeatingBasisFunction` transformer.

entries.name: sklego.preprocessing.TypeSelector
entries.summary: The `TypeSelector` transformer allows to select columns in a DataFrame based on their type. Can be useful in a sklearn Pipeline.

members.name: fit
members.summary: Fit the transformer by saving the column names to keep during transform.

members.name: get_feature_names
members.summary: Alias for `.feature_names_` attribute

members.name: transform
members.summary: Returns a DataFrame with columns (de)selected based on their dtype.

entries.name: sklego.testing.check_shape_remains_same_classifier
entries.summary: Ensure that the estimator does not change the shape of prediction.

entries.name: sklego.testing.check_shape_remains_same_regressor
entries.summary: Ensure that the estimator does not change the shape of prediction.
